method:
Independent fixture oracle using recorded joint feedback, not UI TCP state.

This checks kinematic grip and the requested TCP release (selected point + 7 cm,
horizontal opening plane), not friction or dynamic force closure. Bin/transport
geometry remains diagnostic, not acceptance. No fixture rules enter production.
